records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The accompanying unaudited, consolidated financial statements have been prepared in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States ("GAAP") for interim financial information and with the instructions to Form 10-Q and Rule 10-01 of Regulation S-X. These unaudited, consolidated financial statements contain all adjustments (consisting of normal recurring accruals) necessary to present fairly our financial position as of March 31, 2024 and our results of operations and cash flows for the three months ended March 31, 2024 and 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Amounts for credit losses charged to expense, before recoveries, during each of the three months ended March 31, 2024 and 2023 were $73 and $43 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Pre-tax compensation expense for stock compensation awards recognized in Compensation and benefits in the statements of consolidated income for the three months ended March 31, 2024 and 2023 was $(27) and $126 million, respectively.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Marketable securities valued utilizing Level 1 inputs include active exchange-traded equity securities and equity index funds, and most U.S. government debt securities, as these securities all have quoted prices in active markets.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Our truckload brokerage business continues to be negatively impacted by market conditions, which has resulted in revenue declines.
